description: Local marketplace for the Portfolio Copilot plugin.

plugins.name: portfolio-copilot
plugins.description: Investment plan with calendar, portfolio review, cash deployment, fee-aware rebalancing and stock picking on a LOCAL broker XLSX/CSV export. No broker login, no broker access, no order execution on your export account; on your own eToro account (opt-in), orders go out only after you confirm that exact plan, demo by default.
